subject: [PATCH v6 15/19] selftests/mm: check that one khugepaged pass collapses one window

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a new selftest to check the behavior of khugepaged, specifically that one pass of khugepaged_full_pass() can collapse one window with exactly one collapse attempt attributed to its source pages. The test prepares an aligned window, records its source PFNs from pagemap, runs one khugepaged_full_pass() barrier, and checks if the window came out collapsed as expected. The patch also includes four small helpers in vm_util for reading the trace buffer. The test has been passed on x86-64 4K and arm64 64K architectures.
